sections.what_happened: Zelensky: Ukrainian forces can no longer use Starlink or Starshield 'to shoot down jet-powered shaheds' or guide battlefield drones — 'the maximum speed today is 161 kilometers per hour... Starlink shuts down, and we lose the drone'; restrictions apply on Ukrainian territory but not in the EU — 'a planned operation… to restrict us, cut us off.' The Trump administration denies restricting the service.
sections.what_verified: CNN carries both the allegation and the denial; no wire-independent technical confirmation located in-window.
sections.what_disputed: Trump administration denies restricting the service; SpaceX has not commented in the items located.
sections.why_matters: The 'how does America fight a war it stopped believing in' beat: Starlink limits (Ukraine's claim) + diesel-deal sanctions relief + blocked intel/aid threats (Kyiv Independent) as one thesis — the pressure campaign on Kyiv, stated by both sides. NEVER present the restriction as fact; frame is claim-vs-denial.
